note: Set A and Set B share 18 essentially identical claims, but A adds one further correct and important claim: higher topological charge gives a larger IWA, with a supporting quote from the text. Both sets capture the VVC type/aperture/charge trade-offs, the off-axis monolith telescope, the polarizer purpose, and the Figure 5.5-14b/5.5-15 layout items. Both repeat the VVC 'phase-based' fact under two attribute names and both assert a 'Camera Selector to LOWFS' connection that the schematic does not show (LOWFS taps off near the coronagraph mask, well upstream of the camera selector). Because A includes the IWA trade-off that B omits, A is slightly better.
remarks: The 'Camera Selector -> LOWFS' connection appears in both sets but Figure 5.5-14b places LOWFS under the beam between the polarizers and the coronagraph mask, with only Camera Selector -> Camera and Camera Selector -> IFS shown at the right end; arrow routing in the small schematic is somewhat hard to resolve, hence medium confidence. Both sets also miss the definition of topological charge (number of full 2π radian cycles of the vortex phase ramp) and the statement that the VVC family gave the most favorable IWA/low-order-aberration trade-off among the four families considered. Several figure-label claims (CCD, DM1, DM2, IFS, OAP 5) are supported by Figure 5.5-15 but carry only the bare label as quote, and the two 'component sequence' claims are partial subsequences of the schematic rather than complete paths.
